meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 PR 和 Issue 评论变为聊天讨论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发聊天应用并想让团队在会话中讨论代码。
copy.tagline_en: Turn GitHub PR and issue discussions into chat conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app and want to sync GitHub discussions.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按步骤把 GitHub 频道接进来：复制并注册适配器、安装依赖、构建验证，并引导你设置 bot 账号、令牌和 Webhook。完成后，当你在仓库评论中 @ 它时，它会回复；后续评论也会继续参与。
howto.when: 当你说要接入 GitHub（如“让机器人回复我的仓库评论”或“配置 GitHub 频道”）时，Claude 会开始安装和配置。

say.text: 帮我把 GitHub 集成接进来，让机器人回复 PR 和 issue 评论。
say.note: Claude 会先复制适配器并安装依赖。

say.text: 我的仓库是公开的，用严格模式。
我已经准备好 bot 账号和令牌，继续配置。
say.note: Claude 会写入环境变量和 webhook 配置。

howto.what_en: Claude can configure GitHub integration: copy/register the adapter, install deps, build/test, then set up bot account, token, webhook. After setup, it responds to PR/issue comments when @-mentioned and follows threads.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add GitHub integration (e.g., 'connect my GitHub repo' or 'make the bot reply to comments'). It also guides you through privacy settings and policy choice.

say_en.text: Set up GitHub integration so I can @ you in PR comments.
say_en.note: Claude will copy the adapter and install dependencies.

say_en.text: My repo is public; use strict mode.
say_en.note: Claude will set unknown_sender_policy to strict.

say_en.text: I have the bot token ready; continue with webhook setup.
say_en.note: Claude will configure env vars and webhook.
